en.headline: Government opens 26 hectares at Hung Shui Kiu for university campuses
en.dek: Three plots in the Northern Metropolis university town are open for post-secondary institutions to apply until 31 December, with results expected early next year.
body: The government on Thursday launched three sites totalling about 26 hectares in the Hung Shui Kiu University Town for eligible post-secondary institutions to apply to build or expand campuses.

Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said at a press briefing that Hung Shui Kiu would serve as a centre for applied post-secondary education in smart manufacturing and the cultivation of international talent. The application window closes on 31 December 2026, and a dedicated assessment panel he chairs is expected to announce successful institutions in early 2027.

Education Bureau Secretary Christine Choi Yuk-lin detailed the three zones: Area 1 of about 16.5 hectares west of the planned Hung Shui Kiu MTR station, Area 2 of about 5.3 hectares north of the station, and Area 3 of about 4.4 hectares near the modern logistics area. Institutions may apply for one or more zones to construct permanent campuses, relocate existing facilities, or provide teaching and student support space, subject to a 15 per cent cap on hostel floor area.

The Education Bureau will hold a briefing next week and post application documents on its website. The Hung Shui Kiu project forms part of three university towns planned across the Northern Metropolis, whose combined campus and surrounding areas exceed 1,000 hectares.

zh.headline: 政府推出洪水橋大學城三幅用地 院校申請年底截止
zh.dek: 北都洪水橋大學城共約26公頃校園區用地今日開放申請，合資格專上院校可至12月31日遞交建議，預計明年初公布進駐院校。
body: 政府周四推出洪水橋大學城三幅合共約26公頃用地，供合資格專上院校申請興建或擴建校園。
政務司司長陳國基在記者會表示，洪水橋大學城定位為智能製造應用型專上教育及國際化人才培育中心。申請截止日期為今年12月31日，由他主持的專責審批小組負責審核，預計2027年年初公布獲批院校。
教育局局長蔡若蓮介紹，三個區域分別為：區域一約16.5公頃，位於已規劃屯馬綫洪水橋站以西；區域二約5.3公頃，位於車站以北；區域三約4.4公頃，鄰近現代物流圈。院校可申請一個或多個區域，作興建永久校舍、重置現有校舍或提供教學及學生支援設施等用途，宿舍樓面面積不得超過擬議總樓面的15%。
教育局下周舉行簡介會，並將申請文件上載至網站。洪水橋項目屬北部都會區三個大學城之一，三城總體規劃面積連同周邊超過1,000公頃。
